name: Levan Amashukeli
medium: Flat acrylic and digital painting on canvas
colour: loud and flat — sky blue, chrome yellow, hot orange, pink and pure black, laid down in unbroken areas
form: simplified flattened figures with strong silhouettes, bodies stretched or distorted, no perspective depth
never: never photographic rendering, never soft gradients or shading, never a muted or earthy palette
mood: funny and slightly menacing at the same time
consent: VERBAL agreement — the owner, 2026-09-25: the artist agreed to take part. A short written agreement (share, credit, withdrawal) is still to be signed before any label is sold.
charterBy: Claude's draft from the 18 works, 2026-09-22 — the owner replaces it with the artist's own seven answers
note: the flat ground takes whichever of his colours THIS scene calls for — chrome yellow, hot orange, pink, black or sky blue — sky blue only when the scene wants sky or water, never by habit (art director, 2026-09-25: 'with Levan blue still feels like the preferred option')
